section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Control and ownership for AML compliance

propositions.proposition: 审查所有权结构时，监管要求识别客户的最终受益所有人（UBO）。
source_quotes: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.

evidence_spans.quote: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.

propositions.proposition: 机构应采用风险为本方法设定受益所有权阈值；对于高风险客户，阈值可能低至10%，对于显著更高风险客户可能低至5%。
source_quotes: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.
For certain high-risk customers, the beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5% for customers who pose a significantly higher risk.

outcomes_or_paths: 对于高风险客户，阈值可能低至10%
对于显著更高风险客户，阈值可能低至5%

evidence_spans.quote: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.
For certain high-risk customers, the beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5% for customers who pose a significantly higher risk.

propositions.proposition: 判断UBO时，需合并直接和间接持股，若达到25%阈值则认定为UBO，否则不认定。
source_quotes: most jurisdictions require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% or more
you need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership
Individual D is then considered a UBO with 82% shareholding
Individual C, who owns 10% of Company A directly and an additional 8% indirectly via their 10% ownership of Company B, is not a UBO

basis_or_condition: 受益所有权识别阈值25%或以上
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 合并直接和间接持股，根据阈值判断是否为UBO

evidence_spans.quote: most jurisdictions require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% or more

propositions.proposition: 若公司不存在自然人受益所有人，则应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人。
source_quotes: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified.

trigger_or_context: 公司不存在自然人受益所有人
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人

evidence_spans.quote: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified.
